text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government to spend 6 million Maltese lira ($15 million) to solve stench problems at waste recycling plant in Marsascala bay, a popular tourist resort south of Valletta.
- New drink-drive campaign launched. Malta has a vehicle for every two people.

- The General Workers Union warns Bank of Valletta of industrial action over working hours. GWU, the Malta Union of Bank Employees and the Bank of Valletta are discussing changes to working hours as part of new collective agreement. The issue is being closely watched by the other banks in Malta and the civil service, since it will probably see the end of summer half-days.
- Nationwide shock at age of ecstasy user. A 12-year-old girl hospitalised suffering the side effects of an ecstasy pill which she took at a disco.
